budget.time_policy: caller-owned wall-clock cancellation; pure boundary enforces deterministic explanation-step accounting

determinism.accounting: input, output, reading, graph, context, obligation, fact, form, target, cause, occurrence, dependency, source-span, trace, catalogue-entry, parameter, rendered-codepoint, string, integer, nesting, explanation-work, and memory-policy ceilings are checked before corresponding retention, traversal, projection, grouping, matching, substitution, serialization, or hashing work
determinism.canonicalization: upstream bytes are replayed without rewriting; every target, fragment, step, explanation, candidate, diagnostic, and result uses NFC strings, sorted JSON object keys, compact separators, ASCII escapes, no floats, exact integers, and exactly one trailing newline
determinism.identity: cause, target, explanation, explanation-set, input-result, catalogue, contract, and result identities are full lowercase SHA-256 of complete canonical bytes; IDs and text never substitute for semantic content
determinism.ordering: candidates preserve stable reading-ID order; within each candidate unsupported normal forms preserve their source canonical-form order followed by unsupported obligations in source ordinal order; catalogue selection uses exact predicates then unique ascending priority; targets and explanations use contiguous local ordinals with no heuristic tie breaker
determinism.portability: the same canonical successful MH-044 bytes produce byte-identical explained or failed result bytes across repeated processes, Python hash seeds, supported Python 3.10 through 3.14 interpreters, and Linux, macOS, and Windows

effects.filesystem: none; explain_unsupported_constructs opens no schema, contract, catalogue, source document, path, configuration, cache, environment file, plugin, or repository artifact because every frozen rule, template, and identity is compiled into constants
effects.mutation: input bytes and parsed upstream values are never mutated or retained by mutable alias; result values own immutable exact scalars, tuples, canonical bytes, and reconstructed read-only views
effects.network: none; no model, documentation search, capability service, translation service, package index, telemetry, or external resolver is consulted
effects.process: none; no subprocess, worker, shell, executable lookup, signal, clock, environment, randomness, locale query, dynamic import, filesystem adapter, CLI, MCP, notebook, or transport operation occurs
effects.solver: none; no natural-language parser, legacy parser, NLP or LLM, solver, CAS, simplifier, equivalence oracle, discovery producer, capability registry, planner, proof producer, checker, proof assistant, evaluator, or backend is imported or invoked

ensures: explain_unsupported_constructs returns one closed immutable UnsupportedExplanationResult with status explained, invalid, or exhausted; ordinary malformed input and deterministic budget exhaustion never return a partial target, cause, owner, fragment, step, explanation, catalogue match, input identity, output identity, or authority-bearing exception.

Before inventory or rendering the function strictly reparses and replay-validates the complete canonical MH-044 result and its embedded MH-043, MH-042, MH-041, MH-040, and ProblemIR chain, including every candidate, normal form, context, obligation, trace, unsupported index, status, source reference, identity, and frozen contract, schema, rule, and catalogue binding.

An explained result contains exactly one candidate wrapper for each successful MH-044 candidate in the same stable reading-ID order and preserves exact ambiguity and selection metadata; no cause, owner, fragment, action, template, or comparison groups, selects, ranks, rewrites, or transfers content between readings.

Within each candidate the target inventory contains exactly every normal form with supported false followed by every canonical obligation with supported false, preserving the corresponding source order and multiplicity; a fully supported candidate has exact empty target and explanation arrays and a non-null explanation-set identity.

Every target binds one reading-local ordinal and ID, surface, source registry and reference, form kind where applicable, source semantic identity, exact construct code and bounded parameters, optional context and obligation ownership, complete semantic dependencies, source spans and canonical trace references available from the replayed chain, one reading-bound cause identity, and mathematical_authority false.

For each candidate the sorted unique source semantic identities of targets equal the candidate unsupported_semantic_sha256s index exactly; supported forms and obligations never receive unsupported targets and missing, surplus, duplicated-surface, cross-reading, or fabricated targets fail closed.

Cause identity covers the reading ID, exact construct code and parameters, and complete unsupported semantic content, so repeated equal causes within one reading may share an identity while distinct source occurrences, roles, origins, dependencies, spans, traces, and multiplicity remain separate targets; no cause identity is shared across readings.

Every target has exactly one explanation with the same ordinal, target ID, cause identity, construct code, and parameters, and exactly one frozen catalogue rule selected by complete exact match and ascending unique priority; only the final registered generic fallback may match when no exact rule matches.

Nearest owned fragments name only the exact frozen fragment code, owner boundary, accepted owner contract identity, owner kind, match basis, rule ID, and fallback state; exact matches never claim an unregistered owner and the generic fallback explicitly owns none.

Formalization steps contain only a frozen action code, template IDs, bounded parameters, required-input codes, safety-condition codes, automatic false, requires_user_confirmation true, and mathematical_authority false; no step mutates input, asserts equivalence, promises capability, invokes a backend, or authorizes execution.

English summary and detail strings are rendered solely by substituting complete validated scalar catalogue parameters into the selected frozen templates; missing, surplus, repeated, unknown, malformed, unescaped, control-bearing, or non-NFC parameters fail closed and rendered text is never parsed back as authority.

Explanation, explanation-set, input-result, catalogue, contract, and top-level identities are full lowercase SHA-256 values over complete canonical bytes and independently recomputable without object identity, labels, hash(), repr(), pickle, locale, platform, checkout path, clock, randomness, or backend observations.

Explained output is a support-boundary diagnostic artifact only and mathematical_authority is always false. No source artifact, reading, goal, graph, context, obligation, edge, status, choice, witness, strategy, trace, assumption, semantic identity, truth value, evidence, proof, refutation, checker result, or trust tier is changed or created.

All strings are NUL-free NFC, integers exclude bool and stay in the portable exact range, arrays and nested values remain within fixed ceilings, and subclasses, object.__new__, setattr, dataclasses.replace, copy, deepcopy, pickle, duplicate JSON keys, floats, noncanonical encodings, and repaired outer hashes cannot forge explained state.

MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt, and SystemExit propagate unchanged and can never be converted into explained, supported, available, equivalent, solvable, proved, verified, or otherwise authority-bearing output.

epistemics.exhausted: a deterministic explanation budget was reached before any target or explanation artifact escaped; no support or authority claim is retained
epistemics.explained: all already-declared unsupported occurrences were covered exactly by frozen structural codes, owner-boundary metadata, conservative caller-confirmed steps, and deterministic display text; this is not mathematical evidence or a capability claim
epistemics.invalid: input, replay, inventory, reference, catalogue, template, canonicalization, identity, or immutable-result validation failed and no partial artifact or output identity is returned
epistemics.non_authoritative: targets, nearest fragments, formalization steps, rendered text, and complete results always carry mathematical_authority false and cannot promote a result, discharge an obligation, select a reading, or authorize execution

invariants: The six closed schema hashes and frozen catalogue hash named in requires are compiled into production and independently rebound by validation; accepted artifact bytes are immutable and any drift fails before input use.

The complete MH-044 result bytes are retained in explained serialization, reparsed strictly, replayed from the exact embedded MH-043 chain, and required to reproduce byte-identical MH-044 output before explanations are trusted.

Candidate reading IDs, source graph hashes, semantic graph hashes, unsupported semantic indexes, ambiguity status, and selected reading remain byte-exact with MH-044; candidates never merge or cross-reference.

Target and explanation IDs are candidate-local contiguous target_NNNNNNNN and explanation_NNNNNNNN values matching zero-based ordinals; target and explanation arrays have equal length and align positionally one to one.

Normal-form targets precede obligation targets and preserve the exact upstream sequences; source surface, registry, reference, form kind, semantic identity, context, ordinal, dependencies, spans, and traces are independently projected from the replayed artifacts rather than trusted from output fields.

The set of target source semantic identities equals unsupported_semantic_sha256s while target occurrences retain duplicate semantic identities across distinct source surfaces or references; neither set equality nor cause sharing erases occurrence multiplicity.

Construct descriptors use only exact typed fields: opaque predicate ID and arity, opaque relation kind, logical operator, quantified kind and binder count, unsupported obligation ID and goal mode, or exact source reference for fallback; names and text never imply an owner or action.

Cause hashes include reading identity and complete construct semantic content and exclude source occurrence position only where exact repeated causes may share; a target always retains its distinct occurrence identity and provenance.

Catalogue entry rule IDs and priorities are unique, exactly one final entry is generic fallback, exact entries precede fallback, every template placeholder occurs exactly once in sorted parameter_names, and every owner contract ID and hash matches an accepted manifest artifact.

Exact catalogue matches use only surface plus exact fact kind or exact obligation kind; match_form_kind is additionally exact where declared; no substring, case folding, edit distance, arbitrary priority tie, runtime registry, plugin list, model, or backend result participates.

Generic fallback is selected if and only if no exact entry matches, names owner_boundary none with null contract fields, uses RETAIN_FOR_SEPARATE_CAPABILITY, and cannot claim a nearest executable capability.

All action records require user confirmation, forbid automatic execution, carry at least one required input and safety condition, and cannot rewrite upstream bytes or assert semantic equivalence without an explicit future separately accepted contract.

Template substitution accepts only exact strings and portable integers from the derived parameter object, escapes control-sensitive content deterministically, inserts each declared field once, and yields NUL-free NFC English text within the render ceiling.

Explanation identity covers target and cause identity, construct descriptor, selected rule, owned fragment, formalization step, summary, detail, and non-authority flag; explanation-set identity covers candidate source and semantic graph identities, unsupported index, targets, and explanations.

Explained result identity covers every accepted contract and schema binding, catalogue identity, exact input result, ambiguity state, every candidate and explanation-set identity, diagnostics, reason code, and non-authority flag; self-reference uses a null result_sha256 preimage.

Invalid and exhausted results contain null input and result identities, null embedded normalization result, null ambiguity metadata, no candidates, at least one bounded diagnostic, exact frozen bindings, and mathematical_authority false; explained results contain no diagnostics.

Public result, candidate, target, owned-fragment, step, explanation, and diagnostic values are final immutable exact dataclasses whose fields, nested containers, equality, hash, serializers, parsers, copy behavior, and construction guards are revalidated from canonical bytes.

Production import and effect closure contains only approved dependency-minimal canonical normalization and standard-library pure data, typing, Unicode, JSON, hashing, and immutable-value owners; optional dependencies cannot change output.

No explanation state implies unsupported input is false, impossible, unsolvable, unprovable, unavailable forever, or semantically equivalent to a suggested formalization, and no state grants mathematical authority.
raises: Ordinary wrong types, malformed or noncanonical normalization bytes, invalid or exhausted upstream states, forged bindings, stale hashes, incomplete unsupported inventories, false support flags, unsafe catalogue matches, invalid templates, cross-reading references, and deterministic budget exhaustion return invalid or exhausted UnsupportedExplanationResult values with no partial artifact or identity.

UnsupportedExplanationValidationError with stable kind type, schema, canonical, identity, upstream, inventory, reference, catalogue, template, result, or budget is raised only by explicitly requested strict result parsing, component serialization, canonical result serialization, or hashing boundaries receiving forged, stale, malformed, noncanonical, or over-budget result data.

PermissionError is raised for direct public construction of closed result values; TypeError is raised for subclass and pickle attempts; copy operations either preserve the same closed value identity or fail.
MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt, and SystemExit propagate and are never converted into an ordinary invalid, exhausted, or explained result.
